authority_rule: config/cutover_status.json selects the operational governance plane. Universal Continuity must not silently promote GitHub runtime authority.
required_current_behaviors: reconcile task protocol metadata before next material checkpoint/final durable response
end every final active-durable-task response with verified progress commit receipt

hook_bindings.durable_task_state_location: continuity/tasks/<task>/TASK_MANIFEST.json plus the cutover-status-selected runtime checkpoint when runtime_authority_enabled=true
hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: FrozenDecision/freeze hash, market-day source snapshots, recommendation/review outputs, replay and audit evidence referenced by the owner task
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: GitHub main for rules/config/continuity metadata; executable task state only from the governance plane selected by config/cutover_status.json
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: chat memory and undeclared external/derived caches are non-authoritative; a historical checkpoint does not become current authority by presence
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: stable task_id + market date + freeze hash for market decisions; repository path plus Git blob SHA for GitHub mutations; owner runtime object/version id when runtime authority is enabled
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: Read config/cutover_status.json first, then current task/checkpoint and exact source evidence needed for the material decision; prior-chat reads and later market outcomes cannot substitute
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: current valid task writer/version guard for task state and GitHub blob-SHA compare-and-swap for repository authority; fail closed on mismatch
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: Re-read the authoritative task/checkpoint or mutated GitHub file and verify intended stage, next_action, freeze boundaries and version before reporting COMMITTED
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: A material upstream source/freeze/research correction invalidates dependent recommendation/review evidence; later outcomes may never be backfilled into an earlier frozen decision
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: Preserve FrozenDecision, source/audit/replay evidence and active-task recovery state; delete only superseded non-business mechanisms after stable-identity and dependency checks
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md contradiction/deprecated-wording cleanup with one canonical rule owner; Git history remains the engineering archive
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: None implicitly authoritative. External stores may be referenced only when the active owner/task explicitly designates evidence with stable provenance.
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: evals/scenarios.json, evals/activation_cases.json, VALIDATION_REPORT.md and task-local replay/audit evidence
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: references/maintenance.md: classify data-quality/runtime/trajectory defects and repair the true rule/runtime owner instead of duplicating prose
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: references/maintenance.md: search contradictions/deprecated wording and remove or demote superseded mechanisms only after dependency checks
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: A durable behavior change does not promote until relevant unit/static/contract tests and historical replay pass; preserve FrozenDecision boundaries and HOLD when evidence is insufficient
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: references/learning.md durable-rule proposal provenance plus owner replay cases and daily-review hypotheses
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: references/learning.md: replay at least five frozen cases across at least two regimes with positive/negative samples, zero future-information contamination and no material regression
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md: one canonical owner, contradiction scan and removal/demotion of superseded mechanisms after validated promotion

overrides.evaluator_selection: A-share promotion uses frozen historical replay across regimes and must reject future-information contamination; insufficient evidence remains HOLD/N_A

methodology_assurance.boundary: Profile binding does not change market-day business authority, current task state, FrozenDecision, or prove a live recommendation/review execution.
